material.description: Evidence: scenarios/moba/assets/icons/heroes has 167 PNGs, 5,606,111 bytes in total, largest 82,087 bytes, all 256x256 RGBA from hy3d (copied in as 57 new files). scripts/assets/prep-icons.mjs shrinks icons to the page's draw size (128 px); its manifest scripts/assets/prep-manifest-icons.json lists only the 110 earlier icons, so the 57 new ones were never prepared. The first-draw gate (pages workflow, ceiling 10000 ms) failed on 3d5c3fe5 at a median of 10852 ms (run 40175451538), after the same tree measured 5835 ms earlier and 9352 ms on a rerun. Concurrent big downloads slow the wasm first draw (AGENTS: wasm is the bottleneck). Fix: run prep-icons on the hero icons (the script skips files the manifest already lists), commit the shrunk PNGs and the manifest, publish, and re-run the Pages gate. Acceptance: the icon bytes drop to about 40% of today; the pages first-draw job passes on the pushed sha. Do not change the 10000 ms ceiling; that is the owner's call.
